Ability to work in a fast-changing environment, manage multiple priorities, and support ongoing process and service improvements. Fluency in English and Arabic, both written and spoken, is highly beneficial.

review_candidates.title: Territory Manager
review_candidates.description: Description InspireMD is a commercial-stage global medical device company dedicated to advancing carotid care and helping prevent stroke through innovative medical technologies. Headquartered in Miami, FL, our team brings together expertise across medical technology, clinical research, operations, and commercialization united by a shared commitment to patients, physicians, and clinical excellence. We are seeking an experienced Territory Manager to join our U.S. Commercial organization in Los Angeles, CA. This is a field-based position suited for an accomplished medical device sales professional who understands complex hospital environments and can combine strategic account development, clinical credibility, and disciplined territory management. Job Overview The Territory Manager is responsible for developing and executing territory business strategies to support InspireMD commercial objectives. The role is responsible for cultivating relationships with physicians and healthcare systems to support the development of assigned accounts and provide world class sales and clinical support. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute territory strategies to identify and advance appropriate CAS, TCAR, and neurovascular market opportunities, aligned with applicable product approvals, commercial readiness, and company objectives. Meet or exceed assigned sales goals while building a sustainable foundation for long-term territory growth. Partner with physicians, healthcare professionals, and internal clinical teams to provide appropriate product and procedural support. Collaborate with Commercial Development and other cross-functional partners to support physician and customer education programs, professional education initiatives, and field training activities. Partner with Clinical Affairs to support clinical trial activities and participating sites, as appropriate. Leverage customer and market insights to support account development, commercial readiness, product launches, and broader market development initiatives. Collaborate closely with Field Clinical Specialists, Regional Sales Directors, and other cross-functional partners to deliver consistent customer experience and support successful commercialization activities. Minimum Qualifications Minimum of 5 years of experience in the medical device industry, with experience in vascular, endovascular, neurology, interventional cardiology, radiology, or related interventional specialties. Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences, or healthcare discipline preferred. Prior experience with innovative medical technologies, preferably within the endovascular or related interventional market. Excellent teamwork and people skills. Excellent sales, listening, verbal and written communication and presentation skills. Salary range from $150,000 - $165,000; $200,000+ OTE Physical Requirements Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards, including meeting qualitative and/or quantitative productivity standards. Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards

review_candidates.title: Technical Sales Manager (M/F)
review_candidates.description: Job Requirements Job Location: Poland - Remote Fulltime Job Description We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Sales Manager (M/F) to drive business growth and expand our market presence across Poland and the Baltic States (Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania). In this role, you will be responsible for selling specialised anti-microbial solutions directly into the beverage industry. The ideal candidate combines a strong technical background in chemical and/or food & beverage sales with professional fluency in both a Slavic language (such as Polish) and Russian to effectively communicate with diverse regional clients. Key Responsibilities Market Expansion: Develop and execute a comprehensive strategic sales plan to capture market share within the beverage sector across Poland and the Baltic States. Client Acquisition & Management: Identify, pitch, and secure new B2B accounts with beverage manufacturers, breweries, soft drink producers, and bottling plants while nurturing existing client relationships. Technical Sales & Consultation: Serve as the primary technical liaison, providing expert consultation on chemical applications, ingredient formulation, safety standards, and regulatory compliance within beverage manufacturing processes. Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast regional revenue, and report regularly on market trends, competitor activities, and sales performance metrics. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate closely with customer service, supply chain, and R&D teams to ensure smooth order fulfilment, timely product delivery, and tailored product development. Negotiation & Closing: Lead commercial negotiations, draft competitive pricing proposals, and close sales contracts aligned with company profitability targets. Work Experience Qualifications & Requirements Experience: Minimum 5 years of proven B2B sales experience within the chemical, specialty ingredients, or food & beverage manufacturing industry. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Food Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in English, alongside fluency in Polish (or another Slavic language) and Russian. Regional Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the commercial landscape, industrial networks, and cultural nuances across Poland and the Baltic States. Ability to comfortably translate technical product features, chemical data, and application safety parameters into clear commercial benefits for beverage manufacturers. Travel Availability: Ability and willingness to travel frequently (up to 40-50%) across the assigned territory for client meetings, trade shows, and site visits. Benefits Benefits Compensation We offer competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and an individual bonus program (Sales Incentive Plan). Salary range: monthly gross salary 17 200 PLN – 24 000 PLN, salary is the subject of mutual agreement based on skills and experience. Comprehensive Benefits We provide a variety of benefits to support your financial security, health and wellbeing including retirement plans, health programs, life insurance and medical care. Work-Life & Flexibility We support you in maintaining a balance between working hours and personal life. With our global “Xwork” program, we offer flexible working arrangements in all countries in which we operate. Training & Development We are committed to your professional and personal development and encourage you in the ongoing pursuit of education, training and knowledge through both formal and informal learning. Diversity For us, talent matters, we welcome everyone who commits to our values. We strongly believe that including diverse perspectives makes us more innovative and enhances our competitiveness. Therefore, we embrace the uniqueness of every single individual and are truly committed to supporting our people in developing their individual potential. Contractual Note: The successful candidate will be hired by the regional legal entity, Lanxess Central Eastern Europe.

review_candidates.title: TOP: Systems Integration & Test Engineer - avionické systémy
review_candidates.description: Systems Integration & Test Engineer - avionické systémy Co Tě čeká? Zapojíš se do integrace avionických systémů a zařízení do letounu od prvotního návrhu až po letové zkoušky a certifikaci. Převezmeš odpovědnost za definici, analýzu a správu systémových požadavků i rozhraní mezi HW a SW komponentami. Navrhneš, připravíš, provedeš a vyhodnotíš integrační, funkční a systémové testy. Budeš diagnostikovat a odstraňovat technické problémy na úrovni systémů, subsystémů i jednotlivých zařízení. Zapojíš se do práce v avionickém labu a vývoje testovacích pracovišť, HIL/SIL prostředí i simulací avionických zařízení. Zajistíš automatizaci testů a analýzu dat získaných během zkoušek i provozu. Vytvoříš a budeš spravovat technickou dokumentaci, testovací postupy, protokoly a Interface Control Documents. Budeš úzce spolupracovat s vývojáři embedded SW/HW, Flight Test týmem, certifikací, výrobou i kvalitou. Navážeš komunikaci s dodavateli avionických systémů, testovací techniky a dalšími technickými partnery. Koho hledáme? Tebe, pokud... ✔ Máš za sebou vysokoškolské vzdělání technického směru. ✔ Pohybuješ se v oblasti systémové integrace, embedded systémů, testování nebo HIL/SIL prostředí. ✔ Orientuješ se v HW/SW rozhraních a dokážeš systematicky řešit technické problémy. ✔Dokážeš navrhovat a realizovat integrační, funkční i systémové testy. ✔ Vyhodnocuješ výsledky zkoušek a efektivně identifikuješ příčiny technických problémů. ✔ Pracuješ samostatně a dovádíš technické úkoly k ověřitelným výsledkům. ✔ Vynikáš analytickým myšlením a dokážeš nacházet souvislosti i v komplexních zadáních. ✔ Patří mezi tvé silné stránky spolehlivost a zodpovědný přístup. ✔ Zakládáš si na preciznosti a všímáš si detailů, které mohou rozhodovat o výsledku. ✔ Komunikativní angličtinu na technické úrovni (min. B2) zvládáš bez problému. Co bude Tvé plus, ale není to podmínkou... ✔ Máš zkušenosti s laboratorní měřicí technikou (osciloskop, logický analyzátor, analyzátor datových sběrnic apod.). ✔ Orientuješ se v komunikačních rozhraních CAN, Ethernet, RS-422/485 nebo UART. ✔ Rozumíš principům a využití rozhraní ARINC 429 nebo MIL-STD-1553. ✔ Umíš pracovat s Pythonem, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulinkem nebo dalšími nástroji pro automatizaci testů. ✔ Pracoval jsi s HIL/SIL prostředími, test rigy nebo nástroji pro simulaci a emulaci zařízení. ✔ Umíš pracovat s nástroji pro správu požadavků a konfigurace, například DOORS, Jama, Jira nebo Git. ✔ Působil jsi v oblasti aerospace, defence, automotive, rail nebo v jiném technicky regulovaném oboru. ✔ Orientuješ se v leteckých standardech, jako jsou ARP4754A, DO-160 nebo DO-178C. ✔ Jsi nadšenec do letectví, elektroniky nebo embedded vývoje. ✔ Vlastní technické projekty nebo modelářství jsou součástí Tvých zájmů. Proč v tom lítat s námi? Zapojíš se do vývoje a integrace avionických systémů moderních letounů. Osvojíš si práci s unikátními technologiemi, které nacházejí uplatnění v leteckém průmyslu. Navážeš spolupráci se špičkovými odborníky z oblasti vývoje, testování i certifikace. Rozšíříš své znalosti o letové zkoušky a proces certifikace leteckých systémů. Dostaneš prostor pro odborný rozvoj a realizaci vlastních technických řešení. Zařadíš se do týmu, který stojí za technologiemi budoucnosti českého letectví.

Nous recrutons pour un acteur industriel spécialisé dans les composants techniques à forte valeur ajoutée, partenaire de clients internationaux dans la compétition et l’automobile haute performance. Votre rôle : Développer les relations avec des comptes stratégiques et identifier de nouveaux relais de croissance. À l’interface entre les clients et les équipes techniques, vous accompagnerez les projets depuis les premiers échanges jusqu’à leur concrétisation commerciale. Vos principales missions : Développer et fidéliser un portefeuille international dans le Motorsport, les véhicules haute performance et les hypercars. Comprendre les enjeux techniques des clients pour anticiper leurs futurs besoins. Ouvrir de nouveaux comptes et explorer de nouvelles opportunités de marché. Construire les propositions commerciales et négocier les conditions tarifaires et contractuelles. Coordonner le volet commercial des projets avec le bureau d’études. Piloter les prévisions de ventes, suivre les marges et contribuer aux orientations commerciales. Entretenir votre réseau lors de rendez-vous clients et d’événements professionnels. Votre profil : Vous associez une solide culture mécanique à une expérience confirmée du développement commercial industriel. Nous recherchons : Une formation supérieure technique : ingénieur, technicien ES ou parcours en mécanique complété par une expérience commerciale significative. Entre 5 et 10 ans d’expérience en vente B2B industrielle et en gestion de comptes clés. Une expérience confirmée dans le Motorsport, indispensable, acquise notamment auprès d’écuries, de motoristes, de constructeurs ou de fournisseurs du secteur. Une excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais. L’allemand ou l’italien représente un avantage. Une aisance dans la négociation, la coordination de projets et les échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux. De l’autonomie, un sens du service client et une forte orientation résultats. Une bonne maîtrise des outils digitaux de prospection et de développement commercial. Une connaissance des moteurs thermiques haute performance et de leurs composants sera particulièrement appréciée. Une expérience complémentaire en hypercars, en horlogerie ou en mécanique de précision constituera également un atout. Des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir Intéressé(e) ? Contactez-moi en message privé pour échanger en toute confidentialité. #Recrutement #Motorsport #KeyAccountManagement #BusinessDevelopment #Industrie #Suisse #Vaud

review_candidates.title: Reservation Agent
review_candidates.location: Saint George, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
review_candidates.description: Mandarin Oriental Canouan is looking for a Reservation Agent to join our Reservations team. Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional. Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences. Mandarin Oriental Canouan is a remote island hideaway located on Canouan Island in St. Vincent and the Grenadines, that is fast becoming one of the of the most sought-after luxury destinations in the world. Oriental, Canouan redefines the idyllic tropical island getaway. About The Job Based at the Mandarin Oriental in Canouan, the Reservation Agent provides prompt, courteous and efficient handling of all requests for guest room reservations, changes, cancellations and information. The Agent provides information and assistance to all guests and visitors; coordinates all guest requests for special arrangements or services, courteously and efficiently. As Reservation Agent, you will be responsible for the following duties: Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries, requests, and booking confirmations via phone, email, and online channels. Accurately process individual and group reservations in the hotel’s reservation system, ensuring all details are correct. Ensure that all bookings are aligned with rate strategies, availability, and company policies. Assist in handling special requests, VIP reservations, and pre-arrival communications with attention to detail and service excellence. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of room types, packages, seasonal promotions, and hotel services. Support the Reservations team with daily administrative tasks, such as updating rooming lists, managing waitlists, and confirming deposits. Communicate effectively with Sales, Front Office, Events, and other departments to ensure accurate information flow. Monitor and maintain accurate records for OTA, wholesaler, corporate, and direct bookings. Help identify and correct reservation discrepancies, duplicate bookings, or booking errors. Uphold Mandarin Oriental’s brand standards and tone of communication at every stage of the reservation process. Perform any other reasonable duties as assigned by the Reservations Manager or S&M leadership. As Reservation Agent, We Expect From You Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a Reservation or Front Office role within a luxury hotel environment. Familiarity with reservation systems such as Opera, SynXis, or other CRS/PMS tools. Excellent communication skills in English. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and customer service mindset. Ability to work efficiently under pressure and multitask in a fast-paced environment. Knowledge of OTA channels, GDS systems, and distribution platforms is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Outlook). Passion for hospitality, guest service, and high standards of presentation. Degree or diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, or a related field preferred. Our commitment to you Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously. MOStay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones. Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally. Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role. Local Benefits A competitive salary Company funded health benefits plan Annual home leave We’re Fans. Are you?

review_candidates.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
review_candidates.description: This is a Fully Remote Job About Our Client: The organization operates within the betting exchange industry, focusing on providing a platform for prediction markets and betting activities. It addresses challenges related to platform reliability and user experience in real-money markets, emphasizing compliance and secure transaction flows. The program is a CFTC-certified exchange scaling its presence in the U.S. market, working with a remote engineering team to evolve the platform. About the Opportunity: The QUALITY ASSURANCE ENGINEER role is essential for maintaining and enhancing platform quality across web, mobile, and API layers. This position ensures new features and releases meet stringent quality standards, directly impacting the reliability and user trust of the platform. The engineer collaborates closely with product and engineering teams, contributing to testing strategies and risk mitigation to support smooth feature deployments. Responsibilities: Test new features across web, mobile, and API layers during development. Write, maintain, and execute test cases and test plans. Conduct regression testing cycles and validate builds before release. Perform exploratory testing to uncover issues beyond scripted tests. Test backend and API behavior, including data integrity and error handling. Validate financial transaction flows with attention to real-money product requirements. Document and track defects with clear reproduction steps and severity. Collaborate with automation and mobile QA engineers to identify and contribute to automated tests. Report quality risks, coverage gaps, and suggest process improvements. Requirements: 3 to 5 years of hands-on QA experience with web and/or mobile software. Strong manual testing skills including test case and test plan development. Experience testing APIs using tools like Postman and SQL knowledge for data validation. Familiarity with Jira and test management systems such as TestRail. Experience testing financial, payments, or wallet-related flows. Interest or experience in betting, prediction markets, or sportsbook environments. Ability to utilize AI tools to assist in test design and bug triage. Strong written communication and prioritization skills. Comfortable working in an Agile, fast-paced, remote environment overlapping ET or CT hours. Pay Range and Compensation Package: Compensation ranges from $80,000 to $120,000 per year. Benefits & Perks: Medical, dental, and vision coverage. Flexible time off based on trust and accountability. Fully remote work within the U.S. Culture that respects time and minimizes unnecessary meetings. Equity opportunities aligned with role and market. Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin. Note: TalentHop is a recruitment partner of this role. Please note that all employment decisions, including candidate assessment, interviews, hiring, compensation, and employment terms, are made exclusively by the hiring employer.
